svg.title: coverage agentic ai
svg.desc: Coverage of Engineering Software with Agentic AI. Expect, Delegate, Observe and Decide recur around one accountable change. The book connects needs, specifications, design, context, tools, bounded implementation, independent verification, review, release, history, recovery and learning. Eight missions form two four-mission routes in a workshop service and an existing Treasury router.
svg.text: 12 CHAPTERS · FROM FIRST REQUEST TO LEARNING AND WHOLE COST
Conduct the change: define it, delegate it, check it, decide.
